meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 安装后,你可以把某个群组的智能体从Claude换成Codex。Codex会负责规划任务、调用工具、保存对话历史,并支持续接会话;对话记录存在OpenAI服务端,不留在本地。
howto.when: 当你对某个群组执行切换命令并重启,或把默认提供商设为codex后新建群组时,Codex接管。

say.text: 把群组123的提供商换成Codex,然后重启它。
say.note: Codex将接管该群组的规划和工具调用。

say.text: 把新群组的默认提供商设为Codex。
say.note: 只影响之后新建的群组,现有群组不变。

say.text: 重新认证Codex,更新一下API密钥。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can switch a group's agent from Claude to Codex. Codex then does planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume; conversation history lives on OpenAI's server, not on disk.
howto.when_en: It activates when you run `ncl groups config update --id <group-id> --provider codex` and restart that group, or when you set DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER to codex and create a new group.

say_en.text: Switch group 123 to Codex, then restart it.
say_en.note: Codex will take over planning and tool calls for that group.

say_en.text: Set the default provider for new groups to Codex.
say_en.note: Only affects groups created after this; existing groups stay unchanged.

say_en.text: Re-authenticate Codex and update my API key.
say_en.note: Refreshes the Codex credentials stored in the vault.
